note: Round formats (BUILD_PROMPT.md section 8.1). 'rules' is sent to the AI. 'exchanges' null = set by the Length option. 'word_limit' is the most a turn should be; 'target_words' is a good typed answer (used by the heat thermostat).

formats.name: Rebuttal Duel
formats.blurb: They make a point. You answer it. Back and forth.
formats.rules: The delegate opens with a short point (max 60 words). Then the student and the delegate take turns rebutting each other. Each turn answers the last one.

formats.name: Opening Speech
formats.blurb: You give a short speech. They answer with a question and a rebuttal.
formats.rules: The student gives an opening speech first. Your first reply asks one Point of Information and then gives a short rebuttal. After that, normal back-and-forth for two more exchanges.

formats.name: Points of Information
formats.blurb: They ask 5 sharp questions. You answer each one.
formats.rules: You only ask pointed questions (max 25 words each). Each reply briefly reacts to the student's answer and then asks the next question. Five questions in total.

formats.name: Moderated Caucus
formats.blurb: Quick speeches on one narrow subtopic.
formats.rules: This is a moderated caucus on a narrow subtopic. Keep every turn short and focused on that subtopic. Three exchanges.

formats.name: Bloc Building
formats.blurb: Win them over so they sign your working paper.
formats.rules: The student tries to win your signature on a working paper. You have two hidden must-haves. Only agree to sign when both are addressed.

formats.name: Procedure Drill
formats.blurb: The Chair gives a situation. You name the right motion or point.
formats.rules: You act as the Chair. Describe a committee situation; the student names the right motion or point; you rule it in or out of order.
